reason: npm's own log differs between two Runs of the same build: npm writes its cache hits in completion order, with timings, and names its debug log after the current time. Checked Go against Go on failing-test and syntax-error (ticket 02). The command, exit code and every Finding taken from the log are compared in report.json. Runs that install as a prerequisite of another selected Check add their own case pattern.

schema.drift runs package.install as its prerequisite, so the Run writes npm's own log, which differs between two Runs of the same build (timings such as 'up to date in 162ms'; see the entry above). Only the logs differed on schema-drift in ticket 16.

The same difference as the entry above, for Runs that install as the prerequisite of deps.tree (ticket 20): npm writes its cache hits in completion order, with timings, and names its debug log after the current time, so two Runs of the same build differ. The command, exit code and every Finding of deps.tree are compared in report.json.

npm sbom writes a random serialNumber (a UUID) and the time of the run into every CycloneDX document, so two Runs of the same build differ. The rest of the document was compared with both lines removed when the entry was added (ticket 20), and report.json carries the component count as the metric sbom_components.
